section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1979
title: ## ACCIDENTAL DEATHS A total of 108987 accidental deaths were recorded by the police in the country during 1979 against 118594 accidental deaths recorded in 1978 registering a decline of 8·1 percent in 1979 over 1978. Figures recorded in 1979 are also lower than the figures recorded during the last 5 years i.e. from 1974 to 1978. ## Volume of Accidental Deaths per lakh of population
